newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says franc/mark parity at right level.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says franc/mark parity at right level.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Sunday he thought the exchange rate between the French franc and the mark was at the right level.
Speaking in a interview on radio on Europe 1, Arthuis said. "I think that the parity between the franc and the deutsche mark is at the right level."

"I think that the Germans would not accept in any way, and the European partners would not accept in any way, that France depreciates its currency against the others, there would be a break in this pact of mutual confidence," he said.
He said France had a trade surplus with most of its European partners, especially with Germany, and pointed out that French 10-year bond yields were below the equivalent German yields.
"Nothing justifies a change in the parity," Arthuis said.
